featuresSection.heading: Transform Your Fitness Journey
featuresSection.subheading: Discover how our all-in-one platform empowers you to reach your fitness goals with expert guidance and innovative tools.

features.title: Premium Fitness Equipment & Supplements
features.details: Shop our curated selection of high-quality fitness equipment, supplements, and workout apparel. Enjoy exclusive member discounts and fast shipping on all orders to support your fitness journey.

features.title: Connect with Expert Coaches Online
features.details: Get personalized training from certified fitness professionals. Schedule one-on-one video sessions, receive custom workout plans, and get real-time feedback on your form and progress.

features.title: Custom Meal Plans by Professional Nutritionists
features.details: Receive tailored nutrition guidance from registered dietitians. Get personalized meal plans based on your goals, dietary preferences, and lifestyle, with automatic grocery lists and recipe suggestions.

features.title: 24/7 Support with Smart Workout Analysis
features.details: Our AI assistant analyzes your workout data to provide real-time suggestions, form corrections, and progress tracking. Get instant answers to fitness questions and automated workout adjustments based on your performance.

features.title: Join Group Workouts & Competitions
features.details: Connect with like-minded fitness enthusiasts in our vibrant community. Participate in monthly challenges, group workouts, and leaderboards to stay motivated and accountable on your fitness journey.

about.title: About Us
about.section1: Welcome to our platform! We are building a powerful and accessible ecosystem for athletes, coaches, and nutritionists. Our goal is to make performance tracking, team collaboration, and e-commerce seamless and personalized.
about.section2: Whether you're an individual striving to improve your performance, a coach managing a roster, or a nutritionist crafting perfect meal plans — we have the tools to help you excel.
about.section3: With a clean UI, role-based dashboards, and multilingual support, our app is designed to scale and adapt to every user's unique journey. We believe technology should empower people, not complicate their lives.
about.missionText: Empowering athletes and wellness professionals with modern, intuitive tools that help them unlock their full potential — through data, collaboration, and commerce.
